SELECT twin_context.id, twin_context.active_line_id 
FROM twin_context 
WHERE twin_context.id = ?

SELECT production_lines.id AS production_lines_id, production_lines.plant_id AS production_lines_plant_id, production_lines.code AS production_lines_code, production_lines.name AS production_lines_name, production_lines.description AS production_lines_description, production_lines.takt_seconds AS production_lines_takt_seconds, production_lines.scenario AS production_lines_scenario, production_lines.config_path AS production_lines_config_path 
FROM production_lines ORDER BY production_lines.id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT vehicles.id AS vehicles_id, vehicles.line_id AS vehicles_line_id, vehicles.vin AS vehicles_vin, vehicles.variant AS vehicles_variant, vehicles.batch_id AS vehicles_batch_id, vehicles.started_at AS vehicles_started_at, vehicles.completed_at AS vehicles_completed_at, vehicles.status AS vehicles_status, vehicles.quality_score AS vehicles_quality_score 
FROM vehicles 
WHERE vehicles.line_id = ? ORDER BY vehicles.id DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT predictions.id AS predictions_id, predictions.vehicle_id AS predictions_vehicle_id, predictions.model_version_id AS predictions_model_version_id, predictions.created_at AS predictions_created_at, predictions.as_of_seq AS predictions_as_of_seq, predictions.defect_probability AS predictions_defect_probability, predictions.confidence AS predictions_confidence, predictions.data_completeness AS predictions_data_completeness, predictions.top_features AS predictions_top_features, predictions.outcome AS predictions_outcome, predictions.correct AS predictions_correct 
FROM predictions 
WHERE predictions.vehicle_id = ? ORDER BY predictions.created_at DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT twin_context.id, twin_context.active_line_id 
FROM twin_context 
WHERE twin_context.id = ?

SELECT production_lines.id AS production_lines_id, production_lines.plant_id AS production_lines_plant_id, production_lines.code AS production_lines_code, production_lines.name AS production_lines_name, production_lines.description AS production_lines_description, production_lines.takt_seconds AS production_lines_takt_seconds, production_lines.scenario AS production_lines_scenario, production_lines.config_path AS production_lines_config_path 
FROM production_lines ORDER BY production_lines.id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT max(station_kpis.t) AS max_1 
FROM station_kpis

SELECT stations.id AS stations_id, stations.line_id AS stations_line_id, stations.seq AS stations_seq, stations.code AS stations_code, stations.name AS stations_name, stations.zone AS stations_zone, stations.type_id AS stations_type_id, stations.sensor_profile AS stations_sensor_profile, stations.capacity AS stations_capacity, stations.has_tool AS stations_has_tool, stations.is_inspection AS stations_is_inspection, stations.env_sensitive AS stations_env_sensitive, stations.equipment_generation AS stations_equipment_generation, stations.criticality AS stations_criticality, stations.baseline_cycle_mu AS stations_baseline_cycle_mu, stations.baseline_cycle_sigma AS stations_baseline_cycle_sigma 
FROM stations 
WHERE stations.line_id = ? ORDER BY stations.seq

SELECT station_types.id AS station_types_id, station_types.code AS station_types_code, station_types.sensors_expected AS station_types_sensors_expected 
FROM station_types

SELECT station_kpis.id AS station_kpis_id, station_kpis.station_id AS station_kpis_station_id, station_kpis.t AS station_kpis_t, station_kpis.queue_len AS station_kpis_queue_len, station_kpis.utilization AS station_kpis_utilization, station_kpis.wear AS station_kpis_wear, station_kpis.completed AS station_kpis_completed 
FROM station_kpis JOIN (SELECT station_kpis.station_id AS station_id, max(station_kpis.t) AS mt 
FROM station_kpis GROUP BY station_kpis.station_id) AS anon_1 ON station_kpis.station_id = anon_1.station_id AND station_kpis.t = anon_1.mt

SELECT sensors.station_id AS sensors_station_id, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM sensors GROUP BY sensors.station_id

SELECT vehicle_events.station_id AS vehicle_events_station_id, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM vehicle_events 
WHERE vehicle_events.exited_at >= ? GROUP BY vehicle_events.station_id

SELECT anomalies.station_id AS anomalies_station_id, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM anomalies 
WHERE anomalies.t >= ? GROUP BY anomalies.station_id

SELECT twin_context.id, twin_context.active_line_id 
FROM twin_context 
WHERE twin_context.id = ?

SELECT production_lines.id AS production_lines_id, production_lines.plant_id AS production_lines_plant_id, production_lines.code AS production_lines_code, production_lines.name AS production_lines_name, production_lines.description AS production_lines_description, production_lines.takt_seconds AS production_lines_takt_seconds, production_lines.scenario AS production_lines_scenario, production_lines.config_path AS production_lines_config_path

 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

FROM stations 
WHERE stations.line_id = ? ORDER BY stations.seq

SELECT max(station_kpis.t) AS max_1 
FROM station_kpis

SELECT station_kpis.station_id AS station_kpis_station_id, avg(station_kpis.utilization) AS avg_util, max(station_kpis.queue_len) AS max_queue, avg(station_kpis.queue_len) AS avg_queue 
FROM station_kpis 
WHERE station_kpis.t >= ? GROUP BY station_kpis.station_id

SELECT vehicle_events.station_id AS vehicle_events_station_id, avg(abs(vehicle_events.cycle_dev)) AS avg_abs_dev, count(*) AS n 
FROM vehicle_events 
WHERE vehicle_events.exited_at >= ? GROUP BY vehicle_events.station_id

SELECT machine_events.id AS machine_events_id, machine_events.station_id AS machine_events_station_id, machine_events.t AS machine_events_t, machine_events.event AS machine_events_event, machine_events.wear AS machine_events_wear 
FROM machine_events JOIN stations ON stations.id = machine_events.station_id 
WHERE stations.line_id = ? AND machine_events.t >= ? ORDER BY machine_events.station_id, machine_events.t

SELECT twin_context.id, twin_context.active_line_id

SELECT vehicles.status AS vehicles_status, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM vehicles

SELECT max(vehicles.completed_at) AS max_1

WHERE vehicles.line_id = ?

SELECT min(vehicles.started_at) AS min_1 
FROM vehicles 
WHERE vehicles.line_id = ?

SELECT avg(vehicles.completed_at - vehicles.started_at) AS avg_1 
FROM vehicles 
WHERE vehicles.line_id = ? AND vehicles.status = ?

SELECT stations.zone AS stations_zone, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM stations JOIN defects ON defects.station_id = stations.id 
WHERE stations.line_id = ? GROUP BY stations.zone

SELECT machine_events.id AS machine_events_id, machine_events.station_id AS machine_events_station_id, machine_events.t AS machine_events_t, machine_events.event AS machine_events_event, machine_events.wear AS machine_events_wear 
FROM machine_events JOIN stations ON stations.id = machine_events.station_id 
WHERE stations.line_id = ? ORDER BY machine_events.station_id, machine_events.t

SELECT twin_context.id, twin_context.active_line_id

SELECT production_lines.id AS production_lines_id, production_lines.plant_id AS production_lines_plant_id, production_lines.code AS production_lines_code, production_lines.name AS production_lines_name, production_lines.description AS production_lines_description, production_lines.takt_seconds AS production_lines_takt_seconds, production_lines.scenario AS production_lines_scenario, production_lines.config_path AS production_lines_config_path

SELECT production_lines.id AS production_lines_id, production_lines.plant_id AS production_lines_plant_id, production_lines.code AS production_lines_code, production_lines.name AS production_lines_name, production_lines.description AS production_lines_description, production_lines.takt_seconds AS production_lines_takt_seconds, production_lines.scenario AS production_lines_scenario, production_lines.config_path AS production_lines_config_path 
FROM production_lines ORDER BY production_lines.id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT predictions.id AS predictions_id, predictions.vehicle_id AS predictions_vehicle_id, predictions.model_version_id AS predictions_model_version_id, predictions.created_at AS predictions_created_at, predictions.as_of_seq AS predictions_as_of_seq, predictions.defect_probability AS predictions_defect_probability, predictions.confidence AS predictions_confidence, predictions.data_completeness AS predictions_data_completeness, predictions.top_features AS predictions_top_features, predictions.outcome AS predictions_outcome, predictions.correct AS predictions_correct, vehicles.id AS vehicles_id, vehicles.line_id AS vehicles_line_id, vehicles.vin AS vehicles_vin, vehicles.variant AS vehicles_variant, vehicles.batch_id AS vehicles_batch_id, vehicles.started_at AS vehicles_started_at, vehicles.completed_at AS vehicles_completed_at, vehicles.status AS vehicles_status, vehicles.quality_score AS vehicles_quality_score 
FROM predictions JOIN (SELECT predictions.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, max(predictions.id) AS mid 
FROM predictions GROUP BY predictions.vehicle_id) AS anon_1 ON predictions.id = anon_1.mid JOIN vehicles ON vehicles.id = predictions.vehicle_id 
WHERE vehicles.line_id = ? AND predictions.defect_probability >= ? ORDER BY predictions.defect_probability DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT vehicles.id, vehicles.line_id, vehicles.vin, vehicles.variant, vehicles.batch_id, vehicles.started_at, vehicles.completed_at, vehicles.status, vehicles.quality_score 
FROM vehicles 
WHERE vehicles.id = ?

SELECT station_types.id AS station_types_id, station_types.code AS station_types_code, station_types.sensors_expected AS station_types_sensors_expected 
FROM station_types

SELECT vehicle_events.id AS vehicle_events_id, vehicle_events.vehicle_id AS vehicle_events_vehicle_id, vehicle_events.station_id AS vehicle_events_station_id, vehicle_events.entered_at AS vehicle_events_entered_at, vehicle_events.exited_at AS vehicle_events_exited_at, vehicle_events.cycle_time AS vehicle_events_cycle_time, vehicle_events.cycle_dev AS vehicle_events_cycle_dev, vehicle_events.queue_seen AS vehicle_events_queue_seen, vehicle_events.checklist_result AS vehicle_events_checklist_result, vehicle_events.inspection_result AS vehicle_events_inspection_result, vehicle_events.anomaly_score AS vehicle_events_anomaly_score, vehicle_events.internal_flags AS vehicle_events_internal_flags, stations.id AS stations_id, stations.line_id AS stations_line_id, stations.seq AS stations_seq, stations.code AS stations_code, stations.name AS stations_name, stations.zone AS stations_zone, stations.type_id AS stations_type_id, stations.sensor_profile AS stations_sensor_profile, stations.capacity AS stations_capacity, stations.has_tool AS stations_has_tool, stations.is_inspection AS stations_is_inspection, stations.env_sensitive AS stations_env_sensitive, stations.equipment_generation AS stations_equipment_generation, stations.criticality AS stations_criticality, stations.baseline_cycle_mu AS stations_baseline_cycle_mu, stations.baseline_cycle_sigma AS stations_baseline_cycle_sigma 
FROM vehicle_events JOIN stations ON stations.id = vehicle_events.station_id 
WHERE vehicle_events.vehicle_id = ? ORDER BY vehicle_events.entered_at

SELECT sensor_readings.id AS sensor_readings_id, sensor_readings.vehicle_id AS sensor_readings_vehicle_id, sensor_readings.station_id AS sensor_readings_station_id, sensor_readings.sensor_name AS sensor_readings_sensor_name, sensor_readings.unit AS sensor_readings_unit, sensor_readings.t AS sensor_readings_t, sensor_readings.n_samples AS sensor_readings_n_samples, sensor_readings.mean AS sensor_readings_mean, sensor_readings.std AS sensor_readings_std, sensor_readings.min AS sensor_readings_min, sensor_readings.max AS sensor_readings_max, sensor_readings.status AS sensor_readings_status, sensor_readings.raw AS sensor_readings_raw 
FROM sensor_readings 
WHERE sensor_readings.vehicle_id = ?

SELECT inspections.id AS inspections_id, inspections.vehicle_id AS inspections_vehicle_id, inspections.station_id AS inspections_station_id, inspections.t AS inspections_t, inspections.result AS inspections_result, inspections.defect_id AS inspections_defect_id 
FROM inspections 
WHERE inspections.vehicle_id = ?

SELECT defects.id AS defects_id, defects.vehicle_id AS defects_vehicle_id, defects.station_id AS defects_station_id, defects.t AS defects_t, defects.severity AS defects_severity, defects.true_root_causes AS defects_true_root_causes 
FROM defects 
WHERE defects.vehicle_id = ?
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
